text:
ida: Quick kickoff for 'Community Labs: Mini' launch. Goal: tiny OSS refapp (chat + sem-search), 20-25m webinar, short how-to tutorial, reproducible bench kit, and a gated "mini playbook" for lead capture. Targets: 650 dev signups, 120 attendees.

matt: Dates?

ida: Publish June 7, webinar June 21. Drafts due May 22.

noelle: Bench plan: cpu / small-gpu / 4-bit quant. I'll run p50/p95, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens. Need canonical prompt set (support convo, 600->512 trim summary, and 8 short embedding queries).

diego: Repo: api + tiny static demo, docker + single-click deploy. README with quickstart and expected metrics. Keep examples < 10 lines and include `./deploy.sh`.

matt: Messaging: primary angle = "forkable starter for pragmatic inference". Secondary = "benchmarks you can reproduce." Short TL;DR for socials: one-sentence + emoji.

noelle: Bench runs May 18-21. I'll attach raw CSV + a small plot in the blog and include a short "how we measured" appendix (commands, hardware, image tags).

ida: Lead capture: gated PDF playbook. Form fields: name, email, company size, role, and checkbox "Interested in Dedicated" to route to AEs. Use UTM: campaign=community-labs-mini, source=(webinar|blog|tweet).

diego: I'll wire the form + HubSpot mapping. Also add `interested_dedicated=true` for AE routing.

matt: Webinar format: 6-min demo clip, 8-min bench walkthrough, 6-min ops tips (cache/batching/quant), 10-min live Q. Record demo for promos.

noelle: Add cost-optimization sidebar (quantize + KV cache + batching checklist). I'll include numbers for q4 and q8 when available.

claire-bot: Launch checklist created: https://ok.redwood/launch/community-labs-mini (repo, tutorial, bench csv, slides, gated pdf, form).

ida: Owners: ida (launch), diego (repo+forms), noelle (bench+methods), matt (content+slides). Deadline for asset finalization: May 22.

diego: I'll add a CONTRIBUTING.md so community can submit bench PRs and a GH Action smoke bench on PRs.

matt: Social plan: 5-tweet thread, 2 short demo clips (20s + 45s), LinkedIn post, newsletter mention. Draft copy by May 10.

ida: Approvals on messaging/screenshots by May 24 or we delay. Next sync: May 6 9am PT. Drop blockers here. :rocket:
